- [Project authority](AGENTS.md): implementation, verification, review and delivery.
- [Product specification](SPEC.md): interfaces, initial release and long-horizon research goal.
- [Goal contract](workspace/harness-config/goal-contract.json): live PageIndex comparison gates; a preview release alone does not meet them.
- Local research gaps: `workspace/issues/research-gaps.json` (ignored and untracked).
- Local execution plans: `workspace/exec-plans/` (ignored and untracked).
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): parsing, trees, trigram filtering, Jev and the local Codex host.
- [PTC multimodal design](docs/design/ptc-multimodal-retrieval.md): implemented batch retrieval, Luna Decisions, rich parsing and Agentic OCR contracts; complete live integration and release gates remain pending.
- [Development setup](docs/development.md): external build storage, native runtime, authentication, parse/OCR controls and evaluation environment.
- [Experimental status](docs/experimental-status.md): D1–D7 progress, aggregate checkpoints, retained failures and the next live experiment.
- Local research entry: `docs/research/README.md` (ignored and untracked).
- [Flash stage coverage](crates/gptgrep-pageindex/FLASH_STAGE_COVERAGE.md): verified port stages, LiteParse alternatives and pending parity.
- Local paired plan: `docs/research/paired-baseline-plan.md` (ignored and untracked).
- [Baseline runner](scripts/pageindex_baseline/README.md): reproducible controls, execution and accounting.
- [Local host defaults](config/codex-host.toml): gpt-6-luna / max; account selected at runtime.
- [Full paired evaluation](workspace/harness-tooling/harbor-ablation/full62/README.md): 62 tasks, 34 raw documents, 124 SEARCH trials, separate Judge and INDEX accounting.
- [Release workflow](docs/release.md): source binding, native dependency notices and relocation.

Private continuation evidence lives under `.local/runs/`; exact source revision,
native identities and run receipt hashes belong there and in private Git PoUW
notes. Read the current source and exact selected checkpoint before continuing.

- Explicit paid rich batch: `gptgrep batch --rich --input operations.json --json` supports `search_multimodal` and source-bound `rerank` alongside six local operations. It retains one pinned reader and finite Decisions context, admits all complete output/call shares before submission, returns ordered failures/not_executed, and has no paid cursor or citation grant. `budget.max_decisions_submissions` defaults to8 within the parent cap200. `--decisions-budget FILE` joins the existing original clock; `--model` and `--multimodal-timeout` apply to paid rich operations. Shared context observations are not exact per-batch provider counts; inspect projected cost/usage and unknown fields.

- [Source-bound rerank](docs/rerank.md): `gptgrep rerank --root ROOT --input FILE_OR_DASH --json` accepts only unique stored native/OCR/visual EvidenceRef candidates; content is resolved from one fixed reader. It reranks the supplied pool without document routing, inference cursors, initial-pass or reader citation rights. The rich batch `rerank` member shares the original context and complete prepaid output/call shares.

Foreground OCR: native `gptgrep ocr serve --config CONTROL_JSON --token-env GPTGREP_OCR_SERVE_TOKEN`; authenticated loopback, exact server-held task custody, create-only original-anchor phase and separate PNG confidence-mode qualification. Ordinary queries never start it. Node one-shot wrapper rejects serve. See docs/ocr-serve.md. Runtime qualification remains pending.
